description: Submit a real non-binding inquiry (nezávazná poptávka) to the sales team. They reply to the given e-mail after reviewing the inquiry. Collect the details from get_quote_requirements first and include them in the message.

locale.description: Language of the confirmation e-mail (default cs)

message.description: Inquiry details - locations, floor size, SKU/piece counts, back-room share, barcode coverage, time window, required outputs

services.description: Requested service(s), comma separated. Valid values: Inventura zboží, Inventura majetku, Audit inventur, Remodeling prodejen, Asistovaná inventura, Audit cenovek

name: submit_inquiry
